title: Agria potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Agria potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Agria potato is a potato variety. 80 to 90 days to harvest, 22.6 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Agria is a registered potato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1994 as NSIC 1994 Po 02. It takes 80 to 90 days from planting to harvest, with 22.58 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 80 to 90 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 22.58 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Agria potato takes 80 to 90 days from planting to harvest. That is 18.5 days faster than the average of the 11 potato varieties with a day count, 103.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 22.58 t/ha beats the average of its group, 21.79. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have deep yellow flesh and yellow/rough skin. Dry matter is 18.8 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne.
Where and when to plant Agria potato

It suits highland areas. Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 80 to 90 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 22.58 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Agria?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
